import json, subprocess, sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/workspace/tmp/dev")
import ref, validate_out

def run(reqs):
    payload = b"".join((json.dumps(r) + "\n").encode() for r in reqs)
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload, capture_output=True)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    return [json.loads(l) for l in p.stdout.decode().splitlines()]

cases = [
    # (name, request, expected DFA (accept, next, distance))
    ("match []", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": []}}], "queries": [[], ["a"], ["a", "a"]]},
     ([True, False], [[1], [1]], [0, None])),
    ("startswith []", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": []}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([True], [[0]], [0])),
    ("endswith []", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": []}}], "queries": [["a"]]},
     ([True], [[0]], [0])),
    ("contains []", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": []}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([True], [[0]], [0])),
    ("not match []", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": "match", "path": []}}}], "queries": [[], ["a"]]},
     ([False, True], [[1], [1]], [1, 0])),
    ("allow true + drop match []", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}},
                                                               {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "match", "path": []}}], "queries": [[], ["a"]]},
     ([False, True], [[1], [1]], [1, 0])),
    ("allow true + drop true", {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}},
                                                                {"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": [[], ["a"]]},
     ([False], [[0, 0]], [None])),
    ("no rules", {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [], "queries": [[], ["a"]]},
     ([False], [[0, 0]], [None])),
    ("allow false", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "false"}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([False], [[0]], [None])),
    ("drop false only", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "drop", "when": {"op": "false"}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([False], [[0]], [None])),
    ("empty alphabet allow true", {"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "true"}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([True], [[]], [0])),
    ("empty alphabet no rules", {"services": [], "rules": [], "queries": [[]]},
     ([False], [[]], [None])),
    ("empty alphabet match []", {"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": []}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([True], [[]], [0])),
    ("empty alphabet startswith []", {"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": []}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([True], [[]], [0])),
    ("empty alphabet not match[]", {"services": [], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "not", "arg": {"op": "match", "path": []}}}], "queries": [[]]},
     ([False], [[]], [None])),
    ("match single", {"services": ["a"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "match", "path": ["a"]}}], "queries": [[], ["a"], ["a", "a"]]},
     ([False, True, False], [[1, 2], [2, 2], [2, 2]], [1, 0, None])),
    ("startswith [a] over 2", {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "startswith", "path": ["a"]}}], "queries": [[], ["a"], ["b"], ["a", "b"]]},
     ([False, True, False], [[1, 2, 2], [1, 1, 1], [2, 2, 2]], [1, 0, None])),
    ("endswith [a] over 2", {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "endswith", "path": ["a"]}}], "queries": [[], ["a"], ["b", "a"], ["b"]]},
     ([False, True], [[1, 2, 1], [1, 2, 1]], [1, 0])),
    ("contains [a,b] over 2", {"services": ["a", "b"], "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": {"op": "contains", "path": ["a", "b"]}}], "queries": [[], ["a"], ["a", "b"], ["a", "a", "b"], ["b", "a"]]},
     ([False, False, True], [[1, 0, 2], [1, 2, 2], [2, 2, 2]], [2, 1, 0])),
]
reqs = [c[1] for c in cases]
outs = run(reqs)
bad = 0
for (name, req, exp), out in zip(cases, outs):
    want = ref.ref_compile(req)
    if out != want:
        print("REF MISMATCH", name, json.dumps(out), json.dumps(want)); bad += 1
    d = out["dfa"]
    got = (d["accept"], d["next"], d["distance"])
    if got != exp:
        print("EXPECTED MISMATCH %-28s got %s\n%55s expect %s" % (name, json.dumps(got), "", json.dumps(exp))); bad += 1
    validate_out.validate(out, req, exhaustive_len=6, sample=10)
    # query fields agree with the DFA
    sidx = {s: i for i, s in enumerate(req["services"])}
    for path, res in zip(req["queries"], out["queries"]):
        s = 0
        for tok in path: s = d["next"][s][sidx[tok]]
        assert res == {"state": s, "allow": d["accept"][s], "distance": d["distance"][s]}, (name, res)
print("hand-checked %d cases, %d mismatches" % (len(cases), bad))
